method: Retained original PE instructions joined to matching PDB symbols. No original executable or DLL execution. Portable host mixer evidence is explicitly separate.

SwapSound.arguments: First Names() entry and first DestinationNames() entry; source keys Names/Name and DestinationNames/DestinationName. No iteration over remaining entries. Original empty vector indexing is not a supported portable input.
SwapSound.behavior: Resolve destination through SoundCueManager.GetSoundCue, copy owner/name/valid descriptor into static source-name keyed map. Source key is exact/case sensitive and not normalized by this action. This is replacement for future admissions; no live channel search or stop. Destination GetSoundCue does not consult swaps.
consumers: Play2D0x49c90 consults exactly once immediately before Create2D
Play3D owner0x49d40 and location0x49ea0 consult once after their existing admission gates and before Create3D
SwapSound.delayed_path: ScriptAction.PlaySound Delay>0 calls CreateCue3D0x4a510 then queues Play(channel). It bypasses Play2D/Play3D replacement; existing delayed channel retains its admitted descriptor.
SwapSound.snapshot: A->B followed by B->C produces B for A; replacing A later leaves already admitted channels unchanged.

OnOwnerDeath.order: Thing disposal StopAmbientSound precedes AudioManager.OnOwnerDeath, before actor deregistration.
OnOwnerDeath.filter: Visit AudioManager channel vector; spatial flag channel+8 true and actual Thing pointer channel+70 equals disposed Thing.
OnOwnerDeath.effect: Read GetSourceLocation while owner still exists, clear owner pointer+70, retain final XY at channel+68. No stop, fade, volume or channel release. All matching channels, including admitted/unstarted channels, are detached.

SourceLocation.world: Parent attachment world location plus Thing offset when parent entity alive; otherwise own body XY.
SourceLocation.screen: Thing.UseScreenLocation converts XY using Camera inverse zoom plus Camera position.
SourceLocation.attributes: Set3DAttributes0x3f000 writes source world XY to FMOD position x,0,-y. Raw Thing Z does not participate.

StopAmbientSound.state: Thing.mAmbientSoundId full+0x224, source Thing.Defaults initializes0 atVA1802dbd69.
StopAmbientSound.effect: ZeroID or unavailable channel is no-op; matching allocated channel receives FMOD stop mode0/allow-fadeout. Original function does not reset stored ID.
StopAmbientSound.admission: Thing.PlayAmbientSound2dc150 requires actual ThingData.AmbientSound.valid full+71; existing ID is stopped immediately; copy actual cue and owner PlayCue3DWithCap4a770 cap0, store actual returned ID at Thing+224.

implemented.ownership: Spatial AudioSource retains actor ID plus generation/lifetime; advanceAudio refreshes actual owner worldXY. Disposal helper requires registered actor, detaches matching generation only. Location-only audio has no owner and is unaffected. 2D listener-owner audio has no spatial owner.
implemented.ambient: ActorComponents.ambientSoundId is actual channel storage initialized0. Helper consumes this real state; caller must populate only with actual successful original ambient admission. PlayAmbientSound action/initialization is not implemented by this change.

verification.kind: Actual reconstructed host mixer linked to pinned decoder and original compressed streams, ASan+UBSan; no hardware playback.
checks: Existing channel unchanged after later replacement
Owner generation mismatch does not detach
Actual owner death freeze XY clears reference while remaining spatial
Detached original sound renders nonzero PCM
Ambient/channel stop remains separate from detachment

limits: Spatial screen Thing source conversion is an explicit error until real Camera transform provider is wired. Selected world owners use actual reconstructed world positions.
Proprietary FMOD DSP and playlist randomness are portable adaptations documented in audio event/mixer contracts.
Whole-map ambient admission coverage and speech-component disposal are separate obligations; these helpers do not claim them complete.
FMOD ALLOWFADEOUT source mode is preserved at the control seam; current portable event renderer stops on either stop mode. Proprietary event release tails are not reconstructed.
